nc.description: A light grey 3D rendering depicts a mechanical assembly featuring gears on a tilted plate positioned above a central cylinder.
A gray 3D rendering shows a mechanical track containing a wedge, two small blocks, a cylindrical roller, and a larger block resting on an inclined section.
A light grey cylindrical post is mounted on a rectangular base and features a collar with an angled lever.
A flat grey bar with a circular hole is positioned between a hovering faceted ring and a smooth white rounded object, with its left end joined to a white connector holding three grey faceted blocks.
A symmetrical arrangement of grey geometric shapes, including flat tiles, faceted blocks, and joint pieces, surrounds a larger, complex central structure on a white background.

vc.description: A grey mechanical device is positioned with its lower arms around a white bottle and its upper threaded mechanism aligned over the bottle's opening.
A close-up view shows a light gray mechanical assembly featuring a knurled knob, hinged arms with textured pads positioned around a central gear, and a mounting bracket.
A pair of pliers grips the bolt of a metal clamp wrapped around a vertical pipe attached to a square base.
Three disassembled grey components of a handheld mechanical device, including a handle, an upper attachment, and a lower translucent cup, are positioned to show their threaded connection points.
A central grey mechanical component is surrounded by concentric rings of small metal hinges and stacks of rectangular panels.
